p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u028/system/state/workspace/programs/task-5b07ae42.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Locate framed rectangle and the two colored markers outside it.
    rtop=next(r for r,row in enumerate(g) if 5 in row)
    rbot=max(r for r,row in enumerate(g) if 5 in row)
    cleft=min(c for row in g for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==5)
    cright=max(c for row in g for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==5)
    marks=[(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0,5)]
    # Marker in left/right region determines opposite diagonal assignment;
    # upper markers use their horizontal side, lower markers invert it.
    diag={}
    for r,c,v in marks:
        same=(r<rtop and c<cleft) or (r>rbot and c>cright)
        if same: diag['main']=v
        else: diag['anti']=v
    # Main diagonal occupies upper-left and lower-right.
    a=diag.get('main',marks[0][2]); b=diag.get('anti',marks[-1][2])
    midr=(rtop+rbot)//2; midc=(cleft+cright)//2
    for r in range(rtop+1,rbot):
        for c in range(cleft+1,cright):
            g[r][c]=a if ((r<=midr)==(c<=midc)) else b
    return g
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
